question:
What should come in place of? in the given series?

40 39 37 34 30 ?
solution:
**Given:**

40, 39, 37, 34, 30,?

**Logic: Subtraction of consecutive natural numbers.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3722b70d3ae5ab6406a4cb218aa7928366dc32da55ea034d7c8c5fb44b693fd3.png]
